{{Quote|Reinforcements have arrived.|The droid speaking with Asajj Ventress|<ref name="ARC Troopers">{{TCW|ARC Troopers (episode)}}</ref>}}
This '''battle droid''' was stationed on [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress's]] [[Trident-class assault ship/Legends|Trident-class assault ship]] during the [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|Battle of Kamino]] along with a fellow droid.

==Biography==
Before the assault on [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]], this [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] accompanied Asajj Ventress on her [[Trident (starship)/Legends|Trident starship]] below the seas of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] in her infiltration mission. After the battle began, this [[Droid/Legends|droid]] informed Ventress that the reinforcement, which were disguised as [[Starship/Legends|starship]] debris, have landed in the sea.

==Behind the scenes==
The B1 battle droid, like every battle droid in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''The Clone Wars'' movie]] and [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' TV series]], was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]]. His name was never given.
